segments.sn42.9:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena nāḷandā tadavasari.
segments.sn42.9:1.2: Tatra sudaṃ bhagavā nāḷandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane.
segments.sn42.9:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena nāḷandā dubbhikkhā hoti dvīhitikā setaṭṭhikā salākāvuttā.
segments.sn42.9:2.2: Tena kho pana samayena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto nāḷandāyaṃ paṭivasati mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhiṃ.
segments.sn42.9:2.3: Atha kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi nigaṇṭhasāvako yena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho asibandhakaputtaṃ gāmaṇiṃ nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto etadavoca –
segments.sn42.9:2.4: “ehi tvaṃ, gāmaṇi, samaṇassa gotamassa vādaṃ āropehi.
segments.sn42.9:2.6: ‘asibandhakaputtena gāmaṇinā samaṇassa gotamassa evaṃmahiddhikassa evaṃmahānubhāvassa vādo āropito’”ti.
segments.sn42.9:3.1: “Kathaṃ panāhaṃ, bhante, samaṇassa gotamassa evaṃmahiddhikassa evaṃmahānubhāvassa vādaṃ āropessāmī”ti?
segments.sn42.9:3.2: “Ehi tvaṃ, gāmaṇi, yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ vadehi –
segments.sn42.9:3.3: ‘nanu, bhante, bhagavā anekapariyāyena kulānaṃ anuddayaṃ [anudayaṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)] vaṇṇeti, anurakkhaṃ vaṇṇeti, anukampaṃ vaṇṇetī’ti?
segments.sn42.9:3.4: Sace kho, gāmaṇi, samaṇo gotamo evaṃ puṭṭho evaṃ byākaroti –
segments.sn42.9:3.5: ‘evaṃ, gāmaṇi, tathāgato anekapariyāyena kulānaṃ anuddayaṃ vaṇṇeti, anurakkhaṃ vaṇṇeti, anukampaṃ vaṇṇetī’ti, tamenaṃ tvaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāsi –
segments.sn42.9:3.6: ‘atha kiñcarahi, bhante, bhagavā dubbhikkhe dvīhitike setaṭṭhike salākāvutte mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ cārikaṃ carati?
segments.sn42.9:3.7: Ucchedāya bhagavā kulānaṃ paṭipanno, anayāya bhagavā kulānaṃ paṭipanno, upaghātāya bhagavā kulānaṃ paṭipanno’ti!
segments.sn42.9:3.8: Imaṃ kho te, gāmaṇi, samaṇo gotamo ubhatokoṭikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho neva sakkhati [sakkhiti (sī.) ma. ni.2.83] uggilituṃ, neva sakkhati ogilitun”ti.
segments.sn42.9:3.9: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn42.9:4.1: “Nanu, bhante, bhagavā anekapariyāyena kulānaṃ anuddayaṃ vaṇṇeti, anurakkhaṃ vaṇṇeti, anukampaṃ vaṇṇetī”ti?
segments.sn42.9:4.2: “Evaṃ, gāmaṇi, tathāgato anekapariyāyena kulānaṃ anuddayaṃ vaṇṇeti, anurakkhaṃ vaṇṇeti, anukampaṃ vaṇṇetī”ti.
segments.sn42.9:4.3: “Atha kiñcarahi, bhante, bhagavā dubbhikkhe dvīhitike setaṭṭhike salākāvutte mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ cārikaṃ carati?
segments.sn42.9:4.4: Ucchedāya bhagavā kulānaṃ paṭipanno, anayāya bhagavā kulānaṃ paṭipanno, upaghātāya bhagavā kulānaṃ paṭipanno”ti.
segments.sn42.9:4.5: “Ito so, gāmaṇi, ekanavutikappe [ekanavuto kappo (syā. kaṃ.), ekanavutikappo (pī.)] yamahaṃ anussarāmi, nābhijānāmi kiñci kulaṃ pakkabhikkhānuppadānamattena upahatapubbaṃ.
segments.sn42.9:4.6: Atha kho yāni tāni kulāni aḍḍhāni mahaddhanāni mahābhogāni pahūtajātarūparajatāni pahūtavittūpakaraṇāni pahūtadhanadhaññāni, sabbāni tāni dānasambhūtāni ceva saccasambhūtāni ca sāmaññasambhūtāni ca.
segments.sn42.9:4.7: Aṭṭha kho, gāmaṇi, hetū, aṭṭha paccayā kulānaṃ upaghātāya.
segments.sn42.9:4.8: Rājato vā kulāni upaghātaṃ gacchanti, corato vā kulāni upaghātaṃ gacchanti, aggito vā kulāni upaghātaṃ gacchanti, udakato vā kulāni upaghātaṃ gacchanti, nihitaṃ vā ṭhānā vigacchati [nihitaṃ vā nādhigacchanti (sī. pī.)], duppayuttā vā kammantā vipajjanti, kule vā kulaṅgāroti [kulānaṃ vā kulaṅgāro (sī.)] uppajjati, yo te bhoge vikirati vidhamati viddhaṃseti, aniccatāye aṭṭhamīti.
segments.sn42.9:4.9: Ime kho, gāmaṇi, aṭṭha hetū, aṭṭha paccayā kulānaṃ upaghātāya.
segments.sn42.9:4.10: Imesu kho, gāmaṇi, aṭṭhasu hetūsu, aṭṭhasu paccayesu saṃvijjamānesu yo maṃ evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.sn42.9:4.11: ‘ucchedāya bhagavā kulānaṃ paṭipanno, anayāya bhagavā kulānaṃ paṭipanno, upaghātāya bhagavā kulānaṃ paṭipanno’ti,
segments.sn42.9:4.12: taṃ, gāmaṇi, vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye”ti.
segments.sn42.9:5.1: Evaṃ vutte, asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn42.9:5.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: Dvīhitikāti “jīvissāma nu kho na nu kho”ti evaṃ pavattaīhitikā.
Dukkhā īhiti ettha na sakkā koci payogo sukhena kātunti duhitikā.
Tattha tattha matamanussānaṃ vippakiṇṇāni setāni aṭṭhikāni etthāti setaṭṭhikā.
Salākāvuttāti salākamattavuttā, yaṃ tattha vuttaṃ vāpitaṃ, taṃ salākamattameva ahosi, phale na janayatīti attho.
Uggilitunti dve ante mocetvā kathetuṃ asakkonto uggilituṃ bahi nīharituṃ na sakkhīti.
Ogilitunti pucchāya dosaṃ disvā hāretuṃ asakkonto ogilituṃ anto pavesetuṃ na sakkhīti.

Ito so gāmaṇi ekanavutikappeti bhagavā kathayamānova yāva nikkhanto nāsikavāto na puna pavisati, tāvatakena kālena ekanavutikappe anussari “atthi nu kho kiñci kule pakkabhikkhādānena upahatapubban”ti parijānanatthaṃ.
Idāni dānādīnaṃ ānisaṃsaṃ kathento atha kho yāni tāni kulāni aḍḍhānīti dhammadesanaṃ ārabhi.
Aniccatāti hutvā abhāvo bahunāpi kālena saṅgatānaṃ khaṇeneva antaradhānaṃ.

lines: Salākamattaṃ vuttaṃ etthāti salākā vuttā, purimapade uttarapadalopo.
Ubhatokoṭikanti yadi “kulānudayaṃ na vaṇṇemī”ti vadati,“bhūtā nikkaruṇā samaṇa tumhe”ti vādaṃ āropehi.
Evaṃ sante “kasmā evaṃ dubbhikkhe kāle mahatiyā parisāya parivuto janapadacārikaṃ carantā kulūpacchedāya paṭipajjathā”ti evaṃ ubhatokoṭikaṃ vādaṃ āropehīti gāmaṇiṃ uyyojesi.
Bahi nīharitunti na vaṇṇemi vaṇṇemīti dve ante mocento taṃ pucchitamatthaṃ bahi nīharati nāma.
Tattha dosaṃ datvā codento taṃ apucchaṃ karonto gilitvā viya anto paveseti nāma.
Ito so gāmaṇītiādi attano bhikkhūnaṃ aññesañca atthakāmānaṃ bhikkhappadānena aniṭṭhappattiabhāvadassanatthaṃ āraddhaṃ.
Dānena sambhūtānīti dānamayena puññakiriyavatthunā sammadeva bhūtiṃ vaḍḍhiṃ pattāni.
Saccena ariyavohārena sammadeva bhūtāni uppannāni saccasambhūtānīti āha “saccaṃ nāma saccavāditā”ti.
Tasmiṃ kule padhānapurisānaṃ bhogānaṃ vā sabbaso vināso.
